Particularly for the company, as we maintain profitability-focused product portfolio, shipment of low-margin, mid-sized LCD models continue to shrink. Specifically, in Q4, shipment area for TV and notebook PC panels grew quarter on quarter, while shipment for monitor and tablet panels declined. As a result, despite the strong seasonality, total shipment area rose modestly QoQ to 4.0 million m2. ASP per square meter was $1,297, down 5% quarter on quarter, largely because shipment of certain small and mid-size OLED models were concentrated in Q3.
Although it fell QoQ, it is up 49% year on year, reflecting continued progress in upgrading the business structure toward OLED and supporting expectations that the high level will be maintained going forward.
